title: unit-shard (1/6) fits its limit again; a visual shot master could not draw is not compared (the integrator's red of 2026-11-22)
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the CI job logs read (public, no token), the local runs written on the card page and the card's tests; the shard records (artifacts) were not read.

findings.claim: the seven role cases of tests/console/test_prefs_10f1.py::test_no_preference_opens_a_route_or_shows_a_patient_value_the_defaults_do_not each walk every GET route 99 times (96 preference combinations and three default walks), 150 to 300 s apiece and about 19 to 32 CPU minutes together; every new console GET route adds seven times 99 requests, so the test keeps growing with the console; making it cheaper without changing what it asserts is lane K's (card 10F-1)

with every shard at worksteal the medians are measured again only after green CI shard jobs exist; D-564's rule applied to today's load-schedule figures (33.6 x 1.5) would ask for 50 minutes, so the 40-minute limit is kept on the strength of the schedule fix and is to be read again from the next green shard jobs

the visual job's 'Unable to capture screenshot' on master (jobs 137064002520, 136754404730) was counted as five unreviewed differences; it is now retried twice and, if master still cannot draw a shot, the shot is listed as not compared; the cause in Chromium of the failed capture is not known
